snippet.title: Star Birds Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Featured in last December's Wholesome Snack, Star Birds represents the collaboration of Toukana Interactive, creators of Dorfromantik, and the animation studio kurzgesagt. It's out today in Early Access! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/ #gaming #cozygames #kurzgesagt
